regions.summary: Guancen mountain country at the head of the Fen river: Gujiao, Lan, Jingle, Wuzhai, Loufan, Shenchi, Kelan, Ningwu. Eight small counties, none above 21%.

candidates.name: Guancen
candidates.meaning: Name of the range whose main peak is Luya Shan; the Fen river rises on its south side.
candidates.fit: The range sits on the Ningwu, Kelan and Wuzhai border, inside this region, and the Fen river runs on through Jingle, Loufan and Gujiao; a geographical name suits a region of many small counties.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article; 151 hits with Shanxi, top ones about this mountain.
candidates.source_note: 位于山西省忻州市宁武县、岢岚县和五寨县交界处...为山西境内主要河流汾河的发源地

candidates.name: Loufan
candidates.meaning: From the Loufan, a Di/Rong people of the north Shanxi highlands defeated by Zhao Wuling; the old Loufan county was seated at Ningwu.
candidates.fit: Today's Loufan county holds only 9.5% of the people, but the old Loufan commandery and county were seated inside this region (CHGIS).
candidates.recognisability: Own county article; the people are named in Warring States history.
candidates.source_note: 战国时期，赵武灵王北征，击溃林胡、楼烦 (history section; historical Loufan seats per CHGIS list in sources.md)

candidates.name: Gujiao
candidates.meaning: Named for the 'old crossing' town of Gujiao, which gave Jiaocheng county its name in 596.
candidates.fit: Largest unit at 21% of people and a coal-city; but the region is eight small counties, so one name feels like a part.

regions.notes: Region is Gujiao, Lan, Jingle, Wuzhai, Loufan, Shenchi, Kelan, Ningwu and bits of Hequ and Baode.

regions.summary: Western Lüliang slope down to the Yellow River: Lin, Xing, Fangshan, with Jia and Wubu in Shaanxi.

candidates.name: Guandishan
candidates.meaning: Guandi (Lord Guan) Mountain, the main peak of the Lüliang range at 2831 m.
candidates.fit: Lies mostly in Fangshan and neighbouring counties; Fangshan is only 11% of the region, so fit is partial.
candidates.recognisability: No own article, but 150 hits with Shanxi, many about the Lüliang range.
candidates.source_note: 主峰关帝山，海拔2831公尺; also 方山县: 地处吕梁山中部，最高山峰为关帝山，海拔2830米

candidates.name: Qiushui
candidates.meaning: Qiu river, a Yellow River tributary that flows through Lin county.
candidates.fit: Runs through Lin county, the largest unit at 46%, and the Sanjiao area; a minor river.
candidates.source_note: 地處三川河、湫水河流域

candidates.name: Lin
candidates.meaning: County 'by the river', created 1369; the biggest unit.
candidates.fit: 46% of the region's people and 99.6% of the county, but a one-syllable name reads as a fragment.

regions.notes: The Lüliang name goes to region 20, which holds the prefecture seat Lishi.

regions.summary: Northern Taiyuan: Jiancaoping, Xinghualing and part of Yingze.

candidates.name: Yangqu
candidates.meaning: The Han county Yangqu (215 BC to 528), seated at Yangqu town in today's Jiancaoping district; later Taiyuan's city county.
candidates.fit: Old seat lies in this region; today's Yangqu county is mostly in region 8 (xinzhou).
candidates.source_note: CHGIS: 阳曲县 (县, 215-528) 今山西太原市尖草坪区阳曲镇

candidates.name: Jiancaoping
candidates.meaning: Sharp-grass flat: the district name.
candidates.fit: 59% of the region's people and 90% of the district.

regions.notes: Yangqu would sit beside a real Yangqu county in region 8; Jiancaoping avoids that.

regions.summary: Taiyuan old centre: Yingze and Xinghualing districts.

candidates.name: Taiyuan
candidates.meaning: 'Great plain': the Zuo Zhuan name for the land the god Taigai cleared by taming the Fen river.
candidates.fit: Holds the old city centre of a 3.9M city.
candidates.source_note: “太原”一名始见于春秋时期。《左传·昭公元年》

regions.summary: West Taiyuan: Wanbailin and Jinyuan, with the Jinci springs and the ancient city site.

candidates.name: Jinyang
candidates.meaning: 'North of the Jin water': the city founded in 497 BC, capital of several dynasties and old name of Taiyuan, burned in 979.
candidates.fit: Ancient city lies in Jinyuan district, the second unit here, which is named for the Jin spring at Jinci.
candidates.source_note: 古称晋阳；遂命“晋阳”; 西南角的晋阳古城; 晋源区因晋水源头之所在的晋祠而得名

candidates.name: Wanbailin
candidates.meaning: 'Ten thousand cypress grove': Yan Xishan planned a cypress cemetery there.
candidates.fit: 70% of the region, 98% of the district.

candidates.name: Xiaodian
candidates.meaning: 'Small inn': the town and district name.
candidates.fit: 96% of the region's people.

candidates.name: Pingjin
candidates.meaning: 'Pacify Jin': the Song county made in 979, after the Song destroyed Jinyang.
candidates.fit: Seat was at Chengxi village in Xiaodian; county ran to 1370.
candidates.recognisability: Little known; only in district histories.
candidates.source_note: CHGIS: 平晋县 (县, 979-1370) 今山西太原市小店区城西村一带; Wanbailin article: 宋朝、金朝、元朝时期，当地为平晋县地

candidates.name: Yuci
candidates.meaning: Elm-tree stop, county since 247 BC.
candidates.fit: 86% of the people; Jinzhong's seat.

regions.summary: Yu, Xiyang, Shouyang, Zuoquan, Heshun, Yushe.
Qingxu, Taigu, part of Yuci and Jinyuan.

candidates.name: Taigu
candidates.meaning: 'Great valley': county since 598; home of Shanxi merchant banks.
candidates.fit: 26% of people and 93% of the county.

candidates.name: Qingxu
candidates.meaning: Merger of Qingyuan and Xugou counties; the vinegar town.
candidates.fit: Largest unit at 32%, nearly all the county.

candidates.name: Fenyang
candidates.meaning: 'Sunny side of the Fen river'; home of Fenjiu.
candidates.fit: 38% of people; the prefecture seat.

candidates.name: Fenzhou
candidates.meaning: Fen prefecture, seated at Fenyang for 980 years.
candidates.fit: Seat at Fenyang; covered Wenshui and Jiaocheng too.
candidates.source_note: CHGIS: 汾州 (州, 526-1594) 今山西汾阳市; 汾州府 1595-1911

candidates.name: Pingyao
candidates.meaning: County since 448; its walled old town is a World Heritage site.
candidates.fit: 44% of people.

candidates.name: Jiexiu
candidates.meaning: Where Jie Zitui is said to have died; from Jie's 'rest'.
candidates.fit: 27% of people, 70% of the city.

regions.summary: Lishi (Lüliang's seat), Liulin, Zhongyang, Shilou, Xi, Yonghe.

candidates.name: Lüliang
candidates.meaning: Named for the Lüliang range; the prefecture.
candidates.fit: Holds the prefecture seat Lishi (38% of people).
candidates.source_note: 市人民政府驻离石区永宁中路

candidates.name: Shizhou
candidates.meaning: Stone prefecture, seated at Lishi from 577 to 1260.
candidates.fit: Seat lies at Lishi in this region.
candidates.source_note: CHGIS: 石州 (州, 577-1260) 今山西离石县

regions.notes: Lüliang range runs through several regions.

regions.summary: Xiaoyi, Lingshi, Jiexiu part, Jiaokou, Fenxi.

candidates.name: Xiaoyi
candidates.meaning: 'Filial and righteous'.
candidates.fit: 42% of people.

candidates.name: Lingshi
candidates.meaning: 'Spirit stone': county since 590, with the Lingshi gorge.
candidates.fit: 25% of people, whole county.
